en: Dependent on a state that is not grasped, a state that is not grasped arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is not grasped, a state that is not non-grasped arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is not grasped, states that are both not grasped and not non-grasped arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not derived (*naupādā*), a state that is not derived arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on states that are both not derived and non-derived, a state that is not derived arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are five [conditions] under root;
three under object (*ārammaṇa*) ... pe ... one under prenascence (*purejāta*) and repetition (*āsevana*) ... pe ... five under non-disappearance (*avigata*).
